evidence.quote: Add a payment method and top up your balance.
Billing is pay-as-you-go from a US dollar balance, and the minimum top-up is $5.

access.why: Self-serve key creation but a paid balance (min $5) is required; no free tier, nearest enum is paid_plan_required.

buildability.main_blocker.why: Usage is prepaid credit only; a small paid top-up is needed before any API calls, otherwise no technical blocker.

access_notes: Self-serve: account, payment method, top up USD balance (min $5), create key.
rationale: Self-serve but prepaid pay-as-you-go only; no free tier, so payment is the gate.
